designEvaluation.accuracy: Prefer actual swept impact coordinates and native scalar heights to target/timer sounds. Collision chords and no-bounce stop are declared approximations; radius/reach/range/hearing defaults are game tuning, not calibrated acoustics or surveyed throwing behavior.
designEvaluation.efficiency: Code-based bounds: at most 90 full fixed steps and 91 synchronous sweeps per accepted one-second update (one extra residual sweep on first non-support impact), at most 64 contacts per sweep and 256 listeners per hearing call. Total release-to-support time is bounded at 10 seconds. No CPU/GPU or FPS benchmark claimed.
designEvaluation.narrative: Subjective recommendation for tactical stealth: investigate the actual environmental impact while preserving combat/confirmed-threat priority. No fake player or omniscient chase location is introduced.
designEvaluation.recommendation: Use the bounded deterministic direct lob, first impact cue and quiet vertical settling to support for the first rock slice. Defer scatter, bounce/sliding, calibrated acoustics, damage and broader inventory/AI systems to explicit consumer/future reviews.
